purpose: legislators:PK:Khyber Pakhtunkhwa:general seats for constituencies PK-51 to PK-100
query: List the CURRENT members of the Provincial Assembly of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa (Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Pakistan) holding the general seats for constituencies PK-51 to PK-100, as of 2026-11-15. For each member give full name, constituency code and name (for constituency seats), seat type (general, women_reserved, minority_reserved, other_reserved), party name and acronym, term start, whether the seat was won in a by-election, and source URLs that list this person as a member for this seat. Account for by-elections, deaths, resignations and disqualifications since the general election; omit vacant seats.
text: The 50 occupied general seats PK-51–PK-100 are listed according to the provincial assembly’s member directory and Election Commission party-position records. PK-91 was won in the April 2024 by-election; the other listed members took office following the general election.
